title: Every profile the blueprint ships names its transport, path, response contract, and semantic distinction; a partial profile is refused at boot
asA: operator choosing between the shipped profiles for a deployment context
iWant: each profile to declare its transport, path, response, and semantic model completely, and any partial profile to be refused before it wires anything
soThat: a mis-authored profile does not silently bind an incomplete probe surface that answers wrongly for the supervisor at hand

acceptanceCriteria.description: Each of the shipped profiles (`kubernetes`, `loadBalancer`, `uptimeMonitor`, `systemd`, `dockerHealthcheck`, `reverseProxy`) resolves to a config object whose `transport`, `paths` (or command/notify equivalent), `responseContract`, and `semanticModel` fields are all present and each carries a value from its enumerated set.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with any one of the shipped profile names and no overrides
acceptanceCriteria.when: the profile resolver runs at boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the resolved profile object has non-null `transport`, non-empty `paths` or its transport-appropriate equivalent, non-null `responseContract`, and non-null `semanticModel`

acceptanceCriteria.description: A profile whose configuration is missing any one of transport, path/command/notify surface, response contract, or semantic model is refused at boot with a stable-coded error naming the missing field.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with a profile whose override removes the transport declaration
acceptanceCriteria.when: the profile resolver runs at boot
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process exits with a non-zero code and emits a `PROBE_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE` error naming the missing field and the profile name

acceptanceCriteria.description: The `loadBalancer` profile resolves to a single-endpoint HTTP GET at `/health` (or the configured override) with a `semanticModel` value of `singleHealthSignal`; distinct liveness and readiness handlers are not bound.
acceptanceCriteria.when: the profile resolver runs and the handler set binds
acceptanceCriteria.then: exactly one HTTP GET handler is bound at the profile's resolved path (default `/health`), no handler is bound at `/live` or `/ready`, and the resolved profile's `semanticModel` equals `singleHealthSignal`
